meta.title: Lighter.xyz WebSocket Adapter & Connection
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Create the LighterWebSocketAdapter that can connect and subscribe to real-time data for live trading price updates.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: LighterWebSocketAdapter class exists extending BaseWebSocketAdapter ABC
WebSocket connection works with state tracking (is_connected())
Subscription to trades channel works with confirmation
Message parsing returns TickData or None

architecture-context.pattern: Implement BaseWebSocketAdapter ABC. Support trades, orderbook, candlestick channels.

technical-specifications.spec:
async def connect(self) -> None: self._ws = await websockets.connect(self._ws_url) self._connected = True logger.info("lighter_ws_connected", url=self._ws_url)
def is_connected(self) -> bool: return self._connected and self._ws is not None and self._ws.open
